zh.title: 工業機器人工作站智慧設計平台
zh.summary: 把作業需求、廠房圖面和機器人限制整理成可審查的 2D／3D 工作站方案。
zh.metaDescription: 工業機器人碼垛工作站設計平台：從自然語言需求抽取工程規格、整合廠房 CAD 圖面，檢查機器人可達性並比較節拍估算，輸出可審查的 2D／3D 佈局、CAD 與物料清單。
zh.problem: 規劃碼垛工作站時，工程師要同時考量廠房尺寸、機器人可達性、節拍與設備成本。
zh.challenge: 可操作的佈局取決於座標、設備規格和作業限制。設計過程需要保留每個候選方案的假設，才能回頭調整並比較。
approach: 從自然語言需求抽取工程規格，並整合廠房 CAD 圖面。
篩選機器人與設備候選，建立工作站佈局並檢查空間可達性。
比較候選方案的節拍估算與運動限制，輸出 2D／3D 檢視、CAD 與物料清單。
zh.implementation: 歷史規格記載最佳化後端包含九個連續階段，依序處理佈局搜尋、節拍估算、指標補充、分群排序、運動驗證、候選選擇、相機佈局、安全圍欄與場域物件、最終輸出。節拍是候選設計的估算，用於後續工程審查。
zh.result: 工作站設計可從需求走到 CAD、物料清單與候選佈局，供工程審查。
zh.validation: 公開範圍是軟體設計交付。佈局檢查及節拍估算適用於設定的作業與限制，工廠驗收需依設備和場域另行執行。
zh.disclosure: 保留匿名工程案例，圖像為設計流程示意。客戶圖面、現場資料與設備驗收結果留在原專案。
zh.mediaAlt: 碼垛工作站與機器人配置的概念圖
zh.service: 討論機器人選型與工作站設計

en.title: Industrial Robot Workcell Design Platform
en.summary: Turn operating requirements, facility drawings and robot constraints into reviewable 2D and 3D workcell proposals.
en.problem: Palletizing workcells require trade-offs among facility dimensions, robot reachability, cycle time and equipment cost.
en.challenge: A usable layout depends on coordinate systems, equipment specifications and operating constraints. Each candidate must retain its assumptions so engineers can check and compare it.
approach: Extract engineering requirements from natural language and incorporate facility CAD drawings.
Screen robot and equipment candidates, build workcell layouts and check spatial reachability.
Compare candidate cycle-time estimates and motion constraints, then export 2D and 3D views, CAD and a bill of materials.
en.implementation: Historical engineering documentation describes nine sequential backend stages covering layout search, cycle-time estimation, metric enrichment, clustering and ranking, motion verification, candidate selection, camera layout, safety fencing and site objects, and final output. Cycle times are estimates for candidate designs.
en.result: The design workflow produces CAD, a bill of materials and layout candidates for engineering review.
deliverables: CAD and equipment bill of materials
Layouts and assumptions for engineering review
en.validation: The published scope covers a software design delivery. Layout checks and cycle-time estimates apply to the configured task and constraints. Factory acceptance depends on the physical equipment and site.
en.disclosure: The engineering engagement is anonymized. The artwork illustrates the design workflow. Customer drawings, site data and equipment acceptance results remain with the project.
en.mediaAlt: Concept illustration of a robotic palletizing workcell layout
en.service: Discuss robot selection and workcell design

references.zh: 期刊論文 · 跨資料集比較與驗證
references.en: Journal paper · Cross-dataset comparison and validation

zh.title: 腦波憂鬱症療效預測
zh.summary: 以治療前的額葉腦波，研究如何估計非侵入性腦刺激的反應。
zh.metaDescription: 以治療前的額葉腦波，研究如何估計非侵入性腦刺激的治療反應：擷取線性與非線性腦波特徵、比較分類方法，並做跨資料集比較與驗證；研究模型亦有門診使用經驗。
zh.problem: 非侵入性腦刺激的治療反應因人而異，臨床團隊希望在治療前取得可供判讀的資訊。
zh.challenge: 腦波特徵與療效標註會受到資料群體和治療設定影響，模型需要在清楚定義的研究條件下評估。
approach: 從治療前額葉腦波擷取線性與非線性特徵。
比較腦波特徵與分類方法對治療反應預測的影響。
依論文定義比較不同資料集與門診群體。
zh.implementation: 由創辦人參與的學術研究，模型投入門診研究團隊常規使用。相關研究方法與結果刊於期刊。
zh.result: 已發表跨資料集比較及驗證，研究模型亦有門診使用經驗。
deliverables: 期刊發表與跨資料集比較
zh.validation: 論文定義的群體、比較條件與結果適用於該研究。門診使用狀態由研究團隊成員公開說明。
zh.disclosure: 此頁記載學術合作，呈現研究方法及公開來源。圖像為概念圖，本頁不提供病患資料。
zh.mediaAlt: 額葉腦波特徵用於療效研究的概念圖
zh.service: 討論訊號與臨床 AI 研究

en.title: EEG Research on Depression Treatment Response
en.summary: Use pretreatment frontal EEG to study response to non-invasive brain stimulation.
en.problem: Response to non-invasive brain stimulation varies across patients. Clinical researchers wanted information they could review before treatment.
en.challenge: EEG features and outcome definitions vary with the cohort and treatment setting. The model needs evaluation under clearly specified study conditions.
approach: Extract linear and nonlinear features from pretreatment frontal EEG.
Compare feature sets and classifiers for treatment-response prediction.
Compare datasets and outpatient cohorts under the protocol documented in the paper.
en.implementation: The founder contributed to the academic study, whose model entered routine use by the outpatient research team. The methods and results were published in a journal.
en.result: The study published cross-dataset comparison and validation and has experience with outpatient use.
en.validation: The population, comparisons and results reported in the paper apply to that study. A member of the research team publicly documented outpatient use.
en.disclosure: This page describes an academic collaboration and cites its public research. The artwork is conceptual. Patient data is excluded.
en.mediaAlt: Concept illustration of frontal EEG features for treatment-response research
en.service: Discuss signal processing and clinical AI research

zh.title: 次世代定序影像降噪
zh.summary: 針對微弱的影像目標訊號設計降噪流程，並以影像品質指標評估。
zh.metaDescription: 次世代定序（NGS）影像降噪：分析原始影像中的目標訊號與背景雜訊特徵，結合影像處理與針對訊號特性調整的模型，並以同一影像品質指標與基準方法比較。
zh.problem: 次世代定序影像可能有較強的背景雜訊，影響目標訊號的辨識。
zh.challenge: 降噪需要同時檢查弱訊號保留與背景抑制，避免只因影像變得平滑就判定成效。
approach: 分析原始影像中的目標訊號與背景特徵。
結合影像處理與針對訊號特性調整的模型。
依同一影像品質指標與基準方法比較。
zh.implementation: 把針對影像特性的演算法整理成可比較不同設定的降噪流程。
zh.result: 建立影像降噪流程並依訊號品質評估。
zh.validation: 評估範圍包含影像訊號品質和弱訊號保留。公開資料足以說明方法方向，定量比較需要補齊測試條件。
zh.disclosure: 匿名工程案例。圖像為概念圖，專案原始影像及資料另行管理。
zh.mediaAlt: 生醫影像訊號與背景雜訊的概念圖

en.title: Sequencing Image Denoising
en.summary: Design an image-denoising workflow for weak target signals and assess it using image-quality measures.
en.problem: Strong background noise can make weak target signals difficult to distinguish in sequencing images.
en.challenge: An assessment needs to consider both preservation of weak signals and reduction of background noise. Smoother images alone do not establish better signal quality.
approach: Characterize target signals and background in the source images.
Combine image processing with a model adapted to the signal characteristics.
Compare settings against a reference method using a consistent image-quality measure.
en.implementation: Image-specific algorithms form a denoising workflow for comparing configurations.
en.result: An image-denoising workflow was developed and assessed for signal quality.
en.validation: The assessment concerns image-signal quality and weak-signal retention. The public material describes the approach. Quantitative comparison needs complete test conditions.
en.disclosure: This engineering case is anonymized. The illustration is conceptual. Project images and underlying data are managed separately.
en.mediaAlt: Concept illustration of biomedical image signal and background noise

zh.title: AI 投資研究平台
zh.summary: 以對話工作區整理投資研究，讓公司關係與結論可追溯至原始來源。
zh.metaDescription: AI 投資研究工作區：匯整來源資料並建立可回看的研究筆記，從公開文件整理公司與供應鏈關係並保留原始引用，讓研究結論可追溯至來源，支援多語版本。
zh.problem: 投資研究需要跨文件整理事實、公司關係與時間先後。摘要若和來源脫節，後續很難查證。
zh.challenge: 研究內容會隨新資料變動，資料層需保留文件上下文、版本及關係的來源，才能區分觀察、推論與歷史資料。
approach: 匯整來源資料並建立可回看的研究筆記。
從公開文件整理公司與供應鏈關係，維護原始引用。
在對話工作區組合查詢與筆記，支援多語版本。
zh.implementation: 創辦人參與研發工作。公開案例限於可追溯的資料工程及研究工作區。相關公開論文另載其研究方法。
zh.result: 研究工作區支援回看版本與引用，並連結至公司關係的原始文本。
deliverables: 附來源內文的公司與供應鏈關係資料
zh.validation: 以抽查引用、關係來源和版本順序作為可重現的審查方式。公開範圍為研究工作流。
zh.disclosure: 創辦人研發經歷。頁面討論資料與研究系統，個別策略、績效和交易紀錄不在公開範圍。
zh.mediaAlt: 投資研究工作區與證據連結的概念圖
zh.service: 討論金融資料與 AI 研發

en.title: AI Investment Research Platform
en.summary: Organize investment research in a conversational workspace with traceable company relationships and source-linked findings.
en.problem: Investment research requires piecing together facts, company relationships and event order across documents. Summaries become difficult to check when separated from their sources.
en.challenge: As new information changes the research, the data layer must preserve document context, versions and provenance so users can distinguish observations, interpretations and historical material.
approach: Collect source material and create versioned research notes.
Extract company and supply-chain relationships from public documents and retain citations.
Combine queries and notes in a conversational workspace with multilingual output.
en.implementation: The founder contributed to development. The public case covers traceable data engineering and the research workspace. A separate publication documents the associated research method.
en.result: The research workspace supports version and citation review, including links to the original text for company relationships.
en.validation: Audit citation accuracy, the source text for relationships and version order as reviewable checks. Public disclosure is limited to the research workflow.
en.disclosure: This is founder development experience. The page describes research and data systems. Individual strategies, performance and transaction records remain confidential.
en.mediaAlt: Concept illustration of an investment research workspace with source links
en.service: Discuss financial data and AI engineering

zh.title: 設備廠商技術知識庫問答系統
zh.summary: 先處理不同文件間的矛盾，再回答技術問題並保留引用與版本依據。
zh.metaDescription: 設備廠商技術知識庫問答系統：先依權威與版本規則處理文件間的矛盾，再回答技術問題；答案附可回查的引用與版本選用理由，並支援專家覆核與裁決回寫。
zh.problem: 設備文件與專家意見可能在同一問題上給出不同答案，查到相關段落仍需要判斷適用版本。
zh.challenge: 系統須保存每項主張的出處、文件版本和權威規則，並讓專家追查判斷。
approach: 從文件萃取結構化主張，保存來源和版本。
依權威與版本規則處理衝突，輸出答案、引用及理由。
提供專家審查並將裁決回寫，以測試題檢查版本選擇和引用。
zh.implementation: 把來源專屬的知識卡、權威裁決及人工審查接入問答流程。
zh.result: 回答附有可回查的引用與版本選用理由，並支援專家覆核。
deliverables: 可追溯知識卡及技術問答流程
衝突判斷依據與專家審查介面
zh.validation: 歷史評測分別檢查版本選擇與引用。拒答也可能拿到高版本分數，因此只呈現有明確題集條件的引用結果。
zh.disclosure: 匿名工程案例。圖像為知識流程概念圖，技術手冊與題集另行管理。
zh.mediaAlt: 企業文件、知識卡與引用查核流程的概念圖

en.title: Technical Knowledge Base for Equipment Support
en.summary: Resolve conflicts between source documents before answering, and retain citations and version choices.
en.problem: Equipment manuals and expert notes may disagree. Finding a relevant passage still leaves the question of which version applies.
en.challenge: The system must retain claim provenance, document version and authority rules so that experts can audit a decision.
approach: Extract structured claims from source documents while retaining their source and version.
Apply authority and version rules to resolve conflicts and show the answer, citations and rationale.
Support expert review and update decisions, using an evaluation set to check version selection and citations.
en.implementation: The question-answering workflow connects source-specific knowledge cards, conflict decisions and human review.
en.result: Answers include traceable citations and a version-selection rationale. Experts can review the decisions.
deliverables: Traceable knowledge cards and question-answering workflow
Conflict rationale and expert review interface
en.validation: The historical evaluation checks version selection and citations separately. An abstention can score well on version selection, so this page reports citation results with their test-set context.
en.disclosure: This engineering case is anonymized. The artwork illustrates the knowledge workflow. Technical manuals and evaluation questions are managed separately.
en.mediaAlt: Concept illustration of enterprise documents, knowledge cards and citation checking
en.service: Discuss an enterprise technical knowledge base

zh.title: 建築平面圖自動上色系統
zh.summary: 在使用者設備上辨識房間、套用材質和標註，批次產出樓層圖。
zh.metaDescription: 建築平面圖自動上色系統：在使用者設備上辨識房間與家具，套用材質、陰影與面積標註，保留繪圖人員的修正並批次輸出多樓層圖面，圖面全程在本機處理。
zh.problem: 平面圖分區上色、材質配置和面積標註需要大量重複的繪圖工作。
zh.challenge: 原始圖面的格式、封閉邊界和家具符號可能各不相同。設計需要讓繪圖人員檢查辨識結果及修正。
approach: 以幾何演算法處理標準圖面，依圖面特徵選擇辨識方法。
定位房間與家具，套用材質、陰影及面積標註。
保留繪圖人員的修正及多樓層批次輸出流程。
zh.implementation: 先辨識房間幾何和圖面元素，再在本機套用各樓層的視覺規則。
zh.result: 圖面在本機處理，支援互動換色及多樓層批次輸出。
zh.validation: 驗收可依公開素材測試圖面相容性與輸出正確性，再針對實際裝置紀錄時間。歷史紀錄只量測已有快取的重新合成。
zh.disclosure: 匿名工程案例。圖像為平面圖流程示意，客戶圖面不在公開範圍。
zh.mediaAlt: 自動分區上色與標註平面圖的概念圖

en.title: Automated Floor Plan Coloring
en.summary: Recognize rooms, apply materials and add labels on the user's machine, then export floor plans in batches.
en.problem: Coloring areas, applying materials and annotating floor areas involve repetitive drafting work.
en.challenge: Source drawings vary by format, boundary quality and furniture symbols. Drafters need a way to inspect recognition and correct errors.
approach: Process standardized drawings geometrically and select recognition methods according to drawing features.
Locate rooms and furniture, then apply materials, shadows and area labels.
Retain manual correction and multi-floor batch export workflows.
en.implementation: Room geometry and drawing elements are recognized before local visual rules are applied floor by floor.
en.result: Floor plans are processed locally with interactive color changes and multi-floor batch output.
en.validation: Acceptance can start with compatibility and output checks on public samples, then measure latency on the actual device. The historical timing covers cached recomposition only.
en.disclosure: The engineering case is anonymized. The artwork illustrates the workflow. Customer plans remain confidential.
en.mediaAlt: Concept illustration of floor plan coloring and annotation

zh.scope: 不含原始圖面分析、檔案輸入輸出或整段操作。當時的硬體與重複次數未公開。

en.name: Historical recoloring recomposition on a cache hit
en.method: Apply the colors using the existing cached floor-plan analysis.
en.scope: The timing excludes source analysis, file I/O and the complete interaction. Hardware and repetition count were not published.

zh.title: 養老院即時跌倒監測
zh.summary: 整合邊緣感測、跌倒事件辨識及告警流程。
zh.metaDescription: 養老院即時跌倒監測：整合邊緣感測、跌倒事件辨識及告警流程，依邊緣裝置的運算資源調整執行方式，讓照護人員及時確認可能的跌倒，並保留事件供查核。
zh.problem: 長照場域需要及時辨識可能的跌倒，並讓照護人員能夠確認事件。
zh.challenge: 告警取決於感測位置、場地遮蔽與活動條件。不同場域應分開驗證。
approach: 建立感測資料到事件辨識的處理流程。
依邊緣裝置的運算資源調整執行方式。
把辨識結果交給告警流程並保留事件供查核。
zh.implementation: 由邊緣裝置執行感測資料處理與辨識，再將事件交給照護作業流程。
zh.result: 完成邊緣裝置上的感測、辨識與告警整合。
zh.validation: 驗證需依場域記錄事件定義、觀察期間、感測配置及誤報。這些條件會影響結果的適用範圍。
zh.disclosure: 匿名工程案例。圖像為概念圖，照護場域的原始資料另行管理。
zh.mediaAlt: 長照環境跌倒辨識和告警的概念圖
zh.service: 討論邊緣 AI 部署

en.title: Edge Fall Monitoring for Long-Term Care
en.summary: Combine edge sensing, fall-event recognition and alerts in one workflow.
en.problem: Care facilities need timely identification of possible falls so caregivers can review the events.
en.challenge: Alerts depend on sensor placement, occlusion and environmental activity. Different settings require separate validation.
approach: Connect sensor data to event recognition.
Adapt execution to the resources of the target edge device.
Send detected events to the alert workflow and retain the event for review.
en.implementation: The edge device processes sensor data and identifies an event, then passes that event to the care workflow.
en.result: Edge sensing, recognition and alerts were integrated.
en.validation: A validation report should describe the event definition, observation period, sensor configuration and false alarms for the evaluated site.
en.disclosure: This engineering case is anonymized. The illustration is conceptual. Raw data from care facilities is managed separately.
en.mediaAlt: Concept illustration of fall-event detection and alerts in long-term care

zh.title: 手術中體內紗布即時辨識
zh.summary: 在術中影像中定位患者體內術野可見的紗布，提供影格標記供醫護人員覆核。
zh.metaDescription: 手術中體內紗布即時辨識。圖解從微創手術影片標註體內可見紗布、比較物件偵測模型，到用出現時間線與人工標註對照。附創辦人共同發表的研究與工程驗證範圍。
zh.problem: 紗布置於患者體內術野時，可見範圍會隨取像角度與遮擋變動。畫面上的位置與時間標記能協助醫護回看特定影格。
zh.challenge: 紗布摺疊、變形或部分被組織與器械遮擋時，影像中的外觀可能改變。術野反光與畫面模糊也須納入測試。
approach: 在微創手術影片的影格標註體內術野可見的紗布。
公開研究比較 YOLO 系列與 Faster R-CNN，並評估過濾誤報的調節模組。
將偵測結果轉為紗布出現的時間線，逐影格與人工標註對照。
zh.implementation: 已有 YOLOv6 與 YOLOv7 的紗布單類別設定及訓練入口。針對體內術野的串流方案，規劃分段量測取像、推論及疊圖時間。
zh.result: 已備妥單類別訓練資料切分設定與兩組候選模型的訓練入口。
deliverables: 紗布單類別偵測訓練設定
影像疊圖與人工覆核流程規劃
工況與端到端延遲驗證計畫
zh.validation: 共同發表的研究用手術影片和人工標註驗證辨識與時間線。工程端的串流部署另需以經授權的獨立影像評估漏檢、誤報及端到端延遲。
zh.disclosure: 匿名研發案例。辨識範圍是術中影像裡可見的體內紗布，定位標記供人工覆核。配圖為剖面概念示意。
zh.mediaAlt: 剖面示意圖，辨識框標出患者體內術野中的紗布
zh.service: 討論手術影像辨識技術

en.title: Real-Time Detection of Gauze Inside the Patient During Surgery
en.summary: Locate gauze visible inside the patient during surgery and provide frame-level markers for clinical review.
en.problem: The view of gauze placed inside the patient can change with camera angle and occlusion. Position markers and timestamps help staff revisit a particular frame.
en.challenge: Folding, deformation and partial occlusion by tissue or instruments can change how gauze appears. Glare and blur in the operative field also need separate testing.
approach: Annotate gauze visible inside the patient in frames from minimally invasive surgical video.
The published studies compare YOLO-family detectors and Faster R-CNN, and assess a regulating module for false detections.
Convert detections to a gauze appearance timeline and compare it frame by frame with human annotations.
en.implementation: Single-class gauze configurations and training entry points exist for YOLOv6 and YOLOv7. The planned streaming evaluation of the internal operative field times capture, inference and the overlay separately.
en.result: The existing work includes dataset split definitions and entry points for training both detector candidates.
deliverables: Planned video overlay and human review workflow
Test plan for operating conditions and end-to-end latency
en.validation: The co-authored studies evaluated detection and timelines against human annotations in surgical video. Streaming deployment requires separate validation of misses, false detections and end-to-end latency using authorized held-out clips.
en.disclosure: This anonymized development case covers gauze visible inside the patient in operative footage. Detection boxes support human review. The image is a conceptual cutaway.
en.mediaAlt: Conceptual cutaway with a detection box around gauze in the operative field inside the patient

zh.title: 養豬場豬隻動作即時辨識與追蹤
zh.summary: 以豬舍影像定位多隻豬、串接個體軌跡，規劃即時辨識站立、行走與躺臥等動作。
zh.metaDescription: 養豬場豬隻動作即時辨識與追蹤案例。以固定攝影機畫面串接多目標偵測、個體軌跡與動作辨識，規劃獨立評估交會遮擋、ID 切換和串流延遲。
zh.problem: 同一欄內有多隻豬同時活動。監測需要把連續影格中的位置和行為變化對應到各自的追蹤軌跡。
zh.challenge: 豬隻彼此遮擋、交會或外觀相近時，容易造成軌跡中斷或身分切換。照明變化也會影響畫面品質。
approach: 從固定攝影機影像定位畫面中的多隻豬。
跨影格串接同一個體的定位，記錄單鏡頭內的追蹤 ID 和移動軌跡。
以連續片段評估站立、行走與躺臥等動作，記錄動作起迄時間。
zh.implementation: 工程評估分成單幀偵測、跨影格追蹤與片段動作分類，便於找出漏檢、換號或動作混淆各自出現在哪個階段。
zh.result: 目前公開範圍為豬舍影像的動作分類、個體追蹤及串流效能評估規劃。
deliverables: 多豬隻定位與追蹤 ID 的輸出規格
動作類別與起迄時間的標註規格
畫面遮擋、ID 切換與端到端延遲驗證計畫
zh.validation: 依欄位或錄影時段切分測試片段，分別評估追蹤 ID 切換、動作辨識錯誤和端到端延遲。設計交會、遮擋和不同照明條件的測試情境。
zh.disclosure: 匿名工程評估案例。配圖為概念示意，場域部署和量測結果待確認。
zh.mediaAlt: 豬舍攝影機定位多隻豬並追蹤個體動作的概念圖
zh.service: 討論畜牧場域影像分析

en.title: Real-Time Pig Behavior Recognition and Tracking
en.summary: Locate multiple pigs in barn video, link their trajectories and scope real-time recognition of standing, walking and lying.
en.problem: Several pigs can occupy the same pen at once. Monitoring requires matching changes in position and behavior to each animal’s track.
en.challenge: Overlap, crossing paths and similar appearances can break tracks or switch IDs. Lighting changes can also affect the video quality.
approach: Locate multiple pigs in video from a fixed camera.
Link detections across consecutive frames to assign within-camera track IDs and trajectories.
Evaluate actions such as standing, walking and lying over clips and record their start and end times.
en.implementation: The engineering evaluation separates frame-level detection, tracking and clip-level action classification so reviewers can isolate misses, ID switches and action errors.
en.result: The public scope covers a planned evaluation of behavior classification, individual tracking and streaming performance.
deliverables: Output specification for multi-pig detections and track IDs
Annotation specification for action labels and their timing
Test plan for occlusion, ID switches and end-to-end latency
en.validation: Hold out clips by pen or recording period. Evaluate ID switches, action classification errors and end-to-end latency across crossings, occlusion and lighting conditions.
en.disclosure: An anonymized engineering evaluation case. The illustration is conceptual. Field deployment and measured results await confirmation.
en.mediaAlt: Concept illustration of an overhead camera detecting and tracking pigs in a pen

zh.title: 大學普物個人化 AI 家教
zh.summary: 讓學生依課程內容和理解程度選擇解說、練習與複習。
zh.metaDescription: 大學普通物理個人化 AI 家教：整理課程教材與檢索索引，結合對話介面產生貼近課程的解說和練習，並依學生的理解程度調整練習或複習建議。
zh.problem: 大班普通物理課程中，學生的進度與卡關原因各不相同。
zh.challenge: 解說必須使用課程相關資料，提示也需配合學生的當下進度與使用情境。
approach: 整理課程教材與檢索索引。
結合教材檢索與對話介面，產生貼近課程的解說和練習。
依學生狀態調整練習或複習建議。
zh.implementation: 獨立教學應用把課程檢索和解題練習整合到同一個學習介面。
zh.result: 完成普通物理家教應用，提供學生使用。
deliverables: 對話解說與個人化練習流程
zh.validation: 公開內容展示教學功能和使用情境。判讀學習成效須有獨立的評估設計及資料。
zh.disclosure: 獨立教育應用。圖像為概念圖，學生個資及使用紀錄不在公開範圍。
zh.mediaAlt: 個人化物理家教與教學路徑的概念圖

en.title: Adaptive Introductory Physics Tutor
en.summary: Help students select explanations, exercises and review material based on course content and their progress.
en.problem: Students in a large introductory physics class differ in progress and in the topics where they need help.
en.challenge: Explanations should use course-relevant sources, and prompts should suit the learner's progress and context.
approach: Organize course material and build a retrieval index.
Connect course retrieval and dialogue to support explanations and exercises.
Adapt practice or review recommendations to the learner's state.
en.implementation: The independent educational application combines course retrieval and problem-solving practice in one learning interface.
en.result: An introductory physics tutoring application was implemented and made available to students.
en.validation: The public description covers teaching features and usage. Claims about learning outcomes require a separate evaluation design and data.
en.disclosure: This is an independent educational application. The artwork is conceptual. Student identities and usage records are excluded.
en.mediaAlt: Concept illustration of an adaptive physics tutor and learning path

zh.title: 晶片端生成式 AI｜人物消除與場景生成
zh.summary: 以可重現的桌面 CPU 實驗比較 MI-GAN 與 Telea 的背景修補輸出，並規劃晶片端模型部署驗證。
zh.metaDescription: 比較公開 MI-GAN 人物遮罩修補與 Telea 基準。以桌面 CPU 量測中位數與 p95 延遲，附兩組背景、遮罩與 PSNR，再說明 NPU Runtime 相容性及部署驗收所需證據。
zh.problem: 人物消除需要補回被遮住的背景。部署到裝置時，輸出品質、模型所需記憶體和運算成本都要評估。
zh.challenge: 遮罩誤差、微小遮蔽物與跨幀一致性會改變重建品質。NPU Runtime 支援的算子、動態尺寸、精度與記憶體上限會改變部署選擇。
approach: 取得人物遮罩，檢查邊界誤差並定義補畫範圍。
建立可比較的 GAN 修補或 Diffusion 場景重建候選，檢查輸出品質。
轉換模型、核對 Runtime 相容性，依目標裝置與工作負載執行完整流程驗證。
zh.implementation: 用兩張公開領域背景與自行製作的遮罩比較 MI-GAN 和 OpenCV Telea，保留已知乾淨背景作為參照。另保留可調整遮罩邊界的瀏覽器基準。
zh.result: 可切換場景、遮罩與修補輸出。桌面 CPU 結果同時列出延遲與遮罩內品質，揭示紋理差異影響兩種方法的相對表現。
deliverables: 瀏覽器合成影像重建展示
模型轉換與裝置驗證方法
可供討論的品質及效能驗收規格
zh.validation: 兩組測試各暖機 5 次、量測 30 次。ONNX Runtime CPU 使用 4 執行緒、批次 1；計時納入前後處理。以已知乾淨背景計算遮罩內 PSNR。
zh.disclosure: 使用可公開模型與可公開輸入重現的自主研發專題。證據涵蓋桌面 CPU 靜態圖像推論。NPU、Diffusion、自動人物分割及全影片吞吐尚未量測。
zh.mediaAlt: 人物遮罩與晶片推論流程的概念圖
zh.service: 討論晶片端生成式影像

en.title: On-device Generative Vision: Person Removal and Scene Synthesis
en.summary: Compare measured MI-GAN and Telea inpainting on a desktop CPU and scope model deployment on a target device.
en.problem: Removing a person requires reconstructing the background they covered. Device deployment adds constraints on output quality, memory and compute.
en.challenge: Mask error, fine occlusions and frame-to-frame consistency affect reconstruction. Operator compatibility, dynamic dimensions, precision and memory limits also affect NPU deployment.
approach: Obtain a person mask, inspect errors at its edges and define the reconstruction region.
Compare GAN-based restoration or diffusion-based reconstruction candidates under consistent quality criteria.
Convert the model, verify runtime compatibility, and validate the complete pipeline on the target workload and device.
en.implementation: Use two public-domain backgrounds and controlled masks to run MI-GAN and OpenCV Telea. The clean backgrounds serve as references. An adjustable browser baseline is also available.
en.result: Compare two scenes and their mask, reference and model output. The CPU results show both latency and image quality, including variation across scenes.
deliverables: Model conversion and device validation methods
en.validation: Each measured condition uses five warm-ups and 30 runs. ONNX Runtime CPU uses four threads and batch size one. Timings include preprocessing and postprocessing. Masked PSNR uses the clean background.
en.disclosure: Independent R&D reproduced with a public model and shareable inputs. The evidence covers desktop CPU still-image inference. NPU, diffusion, automatic person segmentation and full-video throughput await measurement.
en.mediaAlt: Concept illustration of a person-mask pipeline and on-device inference

zh.title: 光子運算與故障模擬
zh.summary: 在四通道、四階段 MZI 網格中注入相位與耗損故障，量化輸出功率變化。
zh.metaDescription: 四通道、四階段光子網格故障模擬。調整 MZI 相位、功率耗損與故障位置，逐階段比較理想及故障光強、總功率與相對誤差。附解析式、功率守恆及數值回歸方法。
zh.problem: 光子運算架構對相位誤差與插入損耗敏感，設計初期需要釐清元件變動對輸出的影響。
zh.challenge: 軟體模型需要明示損耗、幅度與功率的定義，才有辦法與未來元件量測對照。
approach: 先以兩個理想 50:50 耦合器與雙臂相位建立可驗證的 MZI。
在四通道網格中交錯配置相鄰耦合元件，逐級傳播複數光場。
比較理想與故障的各埠輸出光強、總功率及相對輸出誤差。
zh.implementation: 互動展示依據複數轉移矩陣，計算四階段 MZI 網格的理想與故障光場。可以選擇輸入通道、故障所在級與元件，再調相位與功率耗損。
zh.result: 可逐階段觀察故障如何傳播，並在同一輸入下比較各埠輸出光功率、總輸出及相對差異。
deliverables: 單一干涉單元的互動式模擬
zh.validation: 用解析式、零輸入、無耗損功率守恆、參數邊界與獨立複數矩陣參考向量驗證。
zh.disclosure: 自主研發的軟體模擬。模型採理想耦合器，未涵蓋實體元件製程、波長相依或晶片量測。
zh.mediaAlt: 科學運算與模擬工作流程的概念圖
zh.service: 討論光子模擬與科學運算

en.title: Photonic Computing and Fault Simulation
en.summary: Inject phase and attenuation faults into a four-channel, four-stage MZI mesh and quantify changes in output power.
en.problem: Photonic systems are sensitive to phase errors and insertion loss. Early design work needs a way to examine how changes in components affect the output.
en.challenge: A software model should specify how it defines loss, amplitude and power so that future device measurements can be compared with its predictions.
approach: Define a verifiable MZI using two ideal 50:50 couplers and an arm phase.
Alternate adjacent couplers in a four-channel mesh and propagate the complex field stage by stage.
Compare power at each port, total output power and relative output error.
en.implementation: A complex transfer-matrix model calculates both ideal and faulty fields in a four-stage MZI mesh. Visitors can choose the input, fault stage and component, phase and power attenuation.
en.result: Follow propagation through each stage and compare per-port power, total output and relative output error with the same input.
en.validation: Analytic cases, zero input, lossless energy conservation, boundary parameters and independent complex reference vectors validate the implementation.
en.disclosure: Independent software simulation using ideal couplers. It excludes fabrication, wavelength dependence and physical device measurements.
en.mediaAlt: Concept illustration of scientific computing and simulation workflows
en.service: Discuss photonic simulation and scientific computing

zh.description: 選擇元件位置並調整相位與功率耗損，逐階段比較理想與故障輸出。模型以解析案例與獨立複數矩陣參考值驗證。

en.title: Four-channel, four-stage fault propagation
en.description: Select a component and vary phase and power attenuation. Compare the ideal and faulty outputs at each stage. Analytic cases and independent complex-matrix reference values validate the model.

zh.title: GPU 運算資源排程
zh.summary: 回放單工作站的真實 CUDA 與 CPU 任務，並用合成佇列比較 FIFO 與回填。
zh.metaDescription: GPU 運算資源排程實跑與回放。檢視單工作站 CUDA 任務與 CPU 任務的提交、啟動、完成及 VRAM 取樣，另以合成工作比較 FIFO 與回填策略的等待差異。
zh.problem: 共享運算環境若同時有多個工作，必須兼顧資源需求、等待順序與資源利用。
zh.challenge: 一個排在前方的大工作可能阻擋後方能先執行的小工作。提高利用率的同時，還要理解不同工作的等待代價。
approach: 為各合成工作定義所需 CPU、VRAM 和執行步數。
依單機資源上限與選擇的 FIFO 或回填策略判斷是否可開始工作。
沿離散時間步釋放資源，更新工作狀態、時間軸和資源尖峰。
zh.implementation: 以隔離的實際排程器啟動兩個受控 CUDA 工作與一個 CPU 工作，保存相對時間、任務狀態和隔離佇列的 VRAM 取樣。另以固定的合成工作比較 FIFO 與回填。
zh.result: 在測試的單 GPU 執行槽設定下，兩件 CUDA 工作依序執行，CPU 工作與第一件 CUDA 工作並行。兩件 CUDA 工作的程序級取樣峰值均為 286 MiB。
deliverables: 可重現的單機排程試驗
工作佇列、狀態與排程時間軸
供選型討論的資源配置方式
zh.validation: 核對實跑開始與結束時間、退出碼和 VRAM 取樣。FIFO 與回填比較沿用合成工作與模擬刻度。
zh.disclosure: 自主研發的單工作站受控實跑使用自行製作的輸入。示範可驗證准入與並行，正式負載吞吐、多 GPU 或多使用者治理需要另行驗證。
zh.mediaAlt: AI 系統與效能評估流程的概念圖
zh.service: 討論 GPU 資源管理及效能工程

en.title: GPU Compute Orchestration
en.summary: Replay measured CUDA and CPU jobs on one workstation, and compare FIFO and backfill using a synthetic workload.
en.problem: A shared compute environment must balance resource demands, queue order and resource usage when several jobs arrive together.
en.challenge: A large job at the head of the queue can block smaller jobs that fit the currently available resources. A policy should make the waiting trade-offs visible.
approach: Set CPU, VRAM and run length for each synthetic job.
Admit jobs under a single-machine resource limit using the selected FIFO or backfill policy.
Release resources in discrete steps and update job status, the timeline and peak consumption.
en.implementation: An isolated run of the real scheduler launched two controlled CUDA jobs and one CPU-only job, recording relative timestamps, job state and test-queue VRAM samples. A separate synthetic workload compares FIFO and backfill.
en.result: Under a one-GPU-job limit, the two CUDA jobs ran in sequence while the CPU job overlapped the first. Sampled per-process VRAM peaked at 286 MiB for each CUDA job.
en.validation: Verify recorded start and end times, exit codes and VRAM samples. FIFO and backfill comparisons use synthetic jobs and simulation ticks.
en.disclosure: Independent single-workstation test with generated inputs. The run validates admission and overlap under the stated settings. Production throughput, multi-GPU scheduling and multi-user governance require separate validation.
en.mediaAlt: Concept illustration of AI systems and performance evaluation
en.service: Discuss GPU resource management and performance engineering

zh.title: 可追溯的科研證據驗證
zh.summary: 以公開的 paper-evidence 驗證核心，檢查研究草稿的引文和數字是否可回溯。
zh.metaDescription: 可追溯的科研證據驗證：以開源 paper-evidence 將文獻原文、來源位置與引文保存為證據卡，驗證引文確實出現在原文、數字可從上下文找到，並保留未獲支持的主張。
zh.problem: 長文獻或多來源摘要可能混淆引用內容與作者的推論，尤其是數字、對象和表述範圍。
zh.challenge: 查到一段相關文字不表示它支持主張。需要把主張依據、原文與適用條件留在同一條稽核鏈上。
approach: 將文獻原文、來源位置與擷取引文保存在證據卡。
驗證引文出現在原文中，並核對數字能否從引文上下文找到。
需要時依公開工具設定語意支持度檢查，保留未支持或相互矛盾的主張。
zh.implementation: 公開工具的標準函式庫核心可獨立檢查文字和數字。語意判斷的設定及額外的文獻搜尋工具另有先決條件。
zh.result: 已對公開查核核心重跑四組合成引文。逐字引用與排版正規化通過，出現在其他段落的數字及原文找不到的引文被攔下。
deliverables: 基本查核範例與公開使用說明
zh.validation: 固定公開版本與合成文字重現查核，停用模糊比對，數字須出現在引文前後各 200 字元的查核範圍。此實跑不含 LLM 語意判斷或科研推論。
zh.disclosure: 已公開的獨立開源工具。這裡只描述可查證的證據驗證功能，科研推論及研究發現由研究者另行評估。
zh.mediaAlt: 文獻證據抽取及引文驗證的概念圖

en.title: Traceable Research Evidence Verification
en.summary: Use the public paper-evidence verification core to check whether quotations and numbers in a research draft trace back to the literature.
en.problem: Summaries of long papers and multiple sources can confuse what the text says with an interpretation, especially for numeric claims and their subjects.
en.challenge: A relevant quote may not support a claim. Claims, source text and applicable context should remain together in an audit trail.
approach: Keep source text, location and extracted quotations on evidence cards.
Verify that the quote appears in the source and that numbers appear in its context.
When configured, check semantic support and preserve incompatible or unsupported claims for review.
en.implementation: The published standard-library core checks text and numeric context separately. Semantic judgment and additional literature search have separate configuration requirements.
en.result: Four synthetic inputs were run against the public quote gate. Exact and normalized quotations passed. A number from a separate section and an unlocated quotation were blocked.
en.validation: Reproduction uses pinned public code and synthetic text, with fuzzy matching disabled and a 200-character numeric window on each side of the quotation. The run does not assess LLM faithfulness or scientific inference.
en.disclosure: This independent tool is open source. The page describes public evidence verification. Researchers separately evaluate scientific inference and the research findings.
en.mediaAlt: Concept illustration of evidence extraction and citation verification

zh.title: 高雜訊專業語音辨識研究
zh.summary: 分開評估專業通訊的自動轉寫與後續資訊抽取，保留原始語句供研究人員核對。
zh.metaDescription: 量維資科創辦人參與的專業語音研究。以急救通訊為研究情境，分開處理雜訊環境的語音辨識、術語校正和結構化資訊抽取。
zh.problem: 專業通訊常有背景雜訊、縮寫和領域術語。原始轉寫的錯誤可能傳至後續資訊抽取。
zh.challenge: 後處理可能讓文字更順暢，也可能改變原始資訊。研究需區分轉寫錯誤、術語校正與抽取錯誤。
approach: 將自動語音辨識與後續術語校正分成兩個階段。
以參考逐字稿檢查轉寫錯誤，另行核對結構化抽取是否維持原句含義。
分別記錄原始轉寫與後處理輸出，讓研究人員能追溯差異。
zh.implementation: 創辦人公開研究履歷列出急救語音辨識評估，以及使用語言模型做專業術語校正與資訊抽取的兩階段流程。公開資料定義了研究方法。
zh.result: 公開來源支持雙階段語音研究敘事。語音辨識與下游資訊抽取各自有驗證範圍。
deliverables: 公開研究方法與流程說明
語音辨識評估與下游抽取的分段設計
zh.validation: 公開摘要支持研究流程，聲學條件、量測結果與適用性需另依已核准的研究報告驗證。
zh.disclosure: 此為創辦人參與的學術研究，範圍限於專業語音。原始音訊、逐字稿、結構化創傷登錄資料及現場成果不在本頁展示範圍。

en.title: Speech Recognition Research for Noisy Professional Audio
en.summary: Evaluate speech recognition and structured information extraction separately, with a trace from the extracted information back to the utterance.
en.problem: Professional radio traffic often contains background noise, abbreviations and domain-specific terminology. Transcription errors can carry into information extraction.
en.challenge: Post-processing can improve readability and also change the meaning. The evaluation needs to distinguish recognition errors, terminology correction and extraction errors.
approach: Separate automatic speech recognition from downstream terminology correction.
Use a reference transcript to examine recognition errors and review whether extracted fields preserve the meaning of the utterance.
Keep the original transcript and corrected output separately so reviewers can trace changes.
en.implementation: The founder's public research profiles describe research into speech recognition for emergency communications and a second stage for domain terminology correction and information extraction.
en.result: The public descriptions establish a research workflow with distinct evaluation boundaries for recognition and downstream extraction.
deliverables: Public research methodology and workflow description
Separate evaluation design for recognition and extraction
en.validation: Public summaries document the workflow. Acoustic conditions, measured performance and applicability each require a released research evaluation.
en.disclosure: This page describes academic research by the founder on professional speech. Source recordings, transcripts, structured trauma-registry records and field outcomes are outside the scope of this page.

zh.title: 自動做市商再平衡研究
zh.summary: 在歷史資料中比較流動性部位的再平衡模型，以固定基準和按時間切分的測試降低比較偏差。
zh.metaDescription: 量維資科創辦人共同發表的自動做市商再平衡研究。以歷史日序列、時間切分和多種基準比較模型，並檢視報酬、Sharpe 比率與最大回撤。
zh.problem: 自動做市商的流動性部位隨市場價格改變，比較再平衡決策時需要固定資料期間和實驗條件。
zh.challenge: 策略的歷史模擬容易受資料切分、基準選擇與交易成本假設影響。比較的適用範圍依賴這些條件。
approach: 將自動做市商的再平衡決策表示為二元分類問題。
按時間切分 BTC/USDC 歷史日資料，使用相同期間比較混合量子經典模型與經典、純量子基準。
依公開論文的模擬設定比較報酬、Sharpe 比率與最大回撤。
zh.implementation: 公開研究比較量子自適應自注意力模組與多組對照。論文描述 2024 年 1 月至 2025 年 1 月的歷史日資料，並依時間分為訓練、驗證與測試集。
zh.result: 已公開方法與歷史模擬比較，可按論文中的資料期間、基準和交易設定解讀。
deliverables: 公開研究論文與比較方法
可核對的資料期間、時間切分與基準說明
zh.validation: 評估範圍是論文所述歷史市場與模擬條件。基準及交易設定應回到論文查驗，頁面未列出可套用於其他資產的報酬數字。
zh.disclosure: 這項公開研究由創辦人共同撰寫，僅描述論文方法與歷史模擬。頁面未展示交易紀錄、客戶資訊或實際資產部位。

en.title: Automated Market Maker Rebalancing Research
en.summary: Compare liquidity-position rebalancing models on historical data using fixed baselines and time-ordered testing.
en.problem: The composition of automated market maker liquidity positions changes with market prices. Comparing rebalancing decisions requires a defined period and shared test conditions.
en.challenge: Historical strategy simulations depend on the data split, choice of baselines and transaction-cost assumptions. Those conditions bound the comparison.
approach: Frame automated market maker rebalancing as a binary decision problem.
Split daily BTC/USDC history in chronological order and compare hybrid quantum-classical models with classical and pure-quantum baselines over the same period.
Compare return, Sharpe ratio and maximum drawdown under the simulation conditions documented in the public paper.
en.implementation: The public study compares a quantum adaptive self-attention module with several controls. It describes daily history from January 2024 through January 2025 and a chronological training, validation and test split.
en.result: The publication provides methods and a historical simulation comparison with a documented period, baselines and trading assumptions.
deliverables: Documented data period, chronological split and baselines
en.validation: The evaluation applies to the market history and simulation conditions reported in the paper. The publication describes its baselines and trading setup. The page publishes no return figure for other assets.
en.disclosure: The founder co-authored the public study. This page describes the research design and historical simulation. Trading records, client data and actual asset positions are outside its scope.
en.mediaAlt: Conceptual illustration of financial research and data analysis
en.service: Discuss financial data and research validation
